sum: The deal
Jordyn Brooks is on a 3-year, $48.05M deal (extension, signed 2026) with $26.50M fully guaranteed. It runs through the 2029 season, plus 1 void year that exists only to spread bonus money.
Cap impact
He counts $6.2M against the 2026 cap (2.1% of the cap), jumping to $17.9M in 2027.
If he's released

Releasing him next offseason before June 1 would leave $28.6M of dead money on the 2027 cap and cost $10.7M of cap room. As a post-June 1 release, 2027 would carry $17.9M (the rest moves to 2028) and save nothing.
